An Absolute Must Visit in Sapa
Jul 2026 • Couples
We had an incredible dinner at Little Sapa Restaurant and couldn't recommend it more!
We ordered the crispy spring rolls, fried beef noodles, grilled beef Little Sapa style, and finished with the burnt banana with rum for dessert. Every dish was beautifully prepared, packed with flavour, and absolutely delicious.
The portions were generous, the prices were very affordable, and we left feeling completely satisfied. The service was warm and welcoming, making us feel right at home from the moment we arrived.
If you're visiting Sapa and looking for authentic Vietnamese food that won't break the bank, make sure you put Little Sapa Restaurant on your list. It was one of the best meals we've had during our Vietnam adventure!
Highly recommended! 🇻🇳🥢❤️

MUST TRY! Amazing food, great value
Mar 2026 • Couples
If you’re staying in Sapa, do yourself a favor and eat at Little Sapa—we ended up dining here three times during our 4-night stay, and honestly, we would have gone back even more if we could.

We visited Sapa as a couple and split our time between exploring the town and doing a two-day trek. After long days out, Little Sapa became our go-to spot for dinner. The food was absolutely faultless every single time—consistently fresh, flavorful, and incredibly satisfying. It’s rare to find a place that delivers that level of quality so reliably, which is exactly why we kept coming back.

A special mention has to go to the Vietnamese pancakes—they are an absolute must-try. Crispy, delicious, and packed with flavor, they quickly became our favorite dish on the menu. We found ourselves craving them even on nights we tried to consider eating somewhere else.

The restaurant was busy every time we visited, which says a lot in itself, but the staff always managed to squeeze us in without making us feel rushed. There’s a really welcoming, efficient vibe despite how popular it is. We also noticed other couples returning multiple times during their stay, which just reinforces how good this place is.

On top of everything, the value for money is fantastic. High-quality food, generous portions, and reasonable prices—it really ticks all the boxes.

If you’re in Sapa, this place is a must. We can’t recommend it highly enough.
